Container.Name: MediaOps
Container.Overview: MediaOps is a self-hosted Discord automation platform for media-server communities. It connects Discord to your media server for health checks, movie and TV discovery, latest additions, random movie selection, Watch Party scheduling, RSVP management and guided community workflows. Emby is currently supported through the MediaProvider architecture; Jellyfin and Plex are planned future providers.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: discord emby watch party media server homelab automation
Container.Requires: Outbound Internet access for Discord and network access to the configured Emby server and Watch Party service.
Container.Changes: Initial public Docker template for MediaOps with GHCR distribution, persistent appdata and guided environment configuration.

Config.Name: MediaOps Data
Config.Description: Persistent MediaOps runtime data and scheduled Watch Party state.

Config.Name: Media Provider
Config.Description: Media provider backend. Emby is currently supported.

Config.Name: Discord Token
Config.Description: Discord bot token. Keep this value secret and rotate it immediately if exposed.

Config.Name: Discord Client ID
Config.Description: Discord application/client ID for the MediaOps bot.

Config.Name: Discord Guild ID
Config.Description: Discord server/guild ID currently used for guild-scoped command deployment.

Config.Name: Emby URL
Config.Description: Emby base URL reachable from this container, for example http://192.168.1.100:8096.

Config.Name: Emby API Key
Config.Description: Emby API key used by MediaOps. Keep this value secret.

Config.Name: Ombi Auto Approve
Config.Description: Automatically approve movie and TV requests submitted through MediaOps. Set to false to require manual approval in Ombi. Recommended: false.

Config.Name: Watch Party URL
Config.Description: Base/public URL of the Watch Party service used by MediaOps.

Config.Name: MediaOps Locale
Config.Description: Default language for automated MediaOps messages. Supported values: en or fr.

Config.Name: MediaOps Data Directory
Config.Description: Container path used for MediaOps-owned persistent runtime data. Leave at /data for standard Unraid deployments.
